{{Quote|Report to forward launch bay, and prepare the long-range assault shuttle for immediate departure to the Yavin system|Admiral [[Termo]]|<ref name="AYF">''[[Star Wars Missions 1: Assault on Yavin Four]]''</ref>}}

A '''long-range assault shuttle''' was a heavily-modified variant of the [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class light cruiser]], dramatically reduced in size.<ref name="AYF" />

The hull had been shortened from its standard length of 350 meters to just 150 meters, and it could be accommodated inside the hangar bay of an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyer]]. Nonetheless, the type retained much of the functionality of its larger siblings. Armament included [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]], its hull was protected by [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflectors]], and it was equipped with a fast [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]. Three [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]] were carried on an external rack.<ref name="AYF" />

The type could also carry at least three [[Squad/Legends|squads]] of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], plus at least one [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]]. <ref name="AYF" />
 
However, most of the crew had been eliminated, with the Navy manpower reduced to a captain, the three [[TIE pilot/Legends|TIE Pilots]], and just four other personnel, including a [[Chief gunnery officer/Legends|chief gunnery officer]].<ref name="AYF" />

Although it could be formally described as a large shuttle, the type was generally referred to as a "cruiser" or "assault cruiser".<ref name="AYF" />

After the Battle of Yavin, a ship of this type under the command of Captain [[Skeezer]] was deployed from the Star Destroyer [[Liquidator (Imperial-class)|''Liquidator'']] to investigate loss of contact with the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]. An unexpected attack by the ''[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]]'' knocked out the sensor array and destroyed the TIE Fighters, forcing the ship to land on Yavin 4, where the stormtroopers were quickly defeated by the Rebels, and Captain Skeezer was taken prisoner.<ref name="AYF" />
